title: PC Harper's killers to stay in jail as PM announces changes to early release scheme
description: Andy Burnham tells BBC Breakfast anyone convicted of manslaughter will be excluded from the early release scheme in the Sentencing Act.

title: Police release one of two men arrested over fatal house fire
description: Police continue to question a 23-year-old man over the fire in which a girl, 7, and her aunt died.

title: British woman killed in stabbing at German railway station
description: A 27-year-old German man was arrested immediately after the incident in Rosenheim, Bavaria.

title: Church names pastor killed by falling sign at Christian festival
description: Robert Guanco, 41, was a pastor at Jesus the Living Water Church in Eastbourne, East Sussex.

title: China censors videos showing deadly flash floods on the Nepal-Tibet border
description: Footage of the flash floods have become almost impossible to find on China’s heavily censored internet.

title: 97-year-old woman rescued after Nepali floods looked like 'a warrior'
description: A 97-year-old woman, Guna Maya Bohara, survived the flash floods and was rescued using an excavator.

title: Footage of Tibet floods isn't being shown in China - and we know little about victims there
description: Some of the most dramatic footage from the deadly flash flooding is hidden from public view in China.

title: What we know about the 33 British nationals missing in Nepal
description: Among those reported missing after deadly floods are a 13-year-old girl and 14-year-old boy.

title: Burnham gets the early prison release changes he wanted - but at what cost?
description: The prime minister says he will keep hundreds more criminals behind bars but doing so requires complex changes.
